stem: A technician rinses a pH probe with tap water and leaves droplets before placing it in a small verification standard. What is the main measurement concern?
choices: Carryover can dilute or contaminate the standard and affect the verification result
Tap water always permanently damages the meter
The probe will measure EC instead of pH
rationale: Carryover between solutions can alter a small standard volume. Proper rinsing and handling reduce contamination and dilution error.
